title: Javanese cemetery marriage-and-sex ritual at a prince's grave

plain: Peter Levenda, whom the episode bills as a CIA historian, says there are cemeteries in Java, Indonesia, where people perform a ritual of marriage and sex at a grave, and that he visited one in particular, at the grave of a prince. He tells Michels it is true and that he saw the place himself.
